sentiment_breakdown.retail_pulse: Cautious but intrigued by sub-$1.00 valuation and $1M Q4 target. Retail discussions on Stocktwits and FinTwit note the top-line miss ($0.51M vs $0.57M), but celebrate the Lunar Outpost contract and 10x YoY revenue surge.
sentiment_breakdown.sell_side_reaction: Constructive on commercial pipeline conversion. WestPark Capital highlights customer expansion to 32 accounts, repeat defense purchasing, and the $63.1M balance sheet as material de-risking achievements.
sentiment_breakdown.management_tone: Resolute, confident, and highly execution-oriented. Matt Fisch and Conor Tierney stressed that software-defined sensing allows AEye to scale across defense, lunar rovers, and sports analytics with minimal incremental CapEx.
sentiment_breakdown.options_iv_crush: Microcap options volume was minimal with negligible open interest. After-hours equity shares slipped -2.25% to $0.87 on modest volume, remaining well within historic trading ranges.

after_hours_driver: AEye shares dipped -2.25% to $0.87 in after-hours trading as Q3 revenue ($0.51M) came in below Street consensus ($0.57M). However, the downside was cushioned by management's strong forward guidance of approximately doubling Q4 revenue to ~$1.00M, gross margin improvement from -80% to -33%, customer accounts growing to 32, and cash surging to $63.1M extending operating runway into 2028.
